message: plan-build says to commit exactly PLAN.md, PROGRESS.md, foundry.json and CLAUDE.md, but docs/SPEC.md itself was untracked (and a .gitignore line SPEC relies on was uncommitted); the skill gives no guidance for that state, so the planner had to decide on its own to include them in the plan commit.

P2-08's foundry_verify extraVerify for scripts/live/*-touched files runs "LIVE_SKIP_ATTACHMENTS=1 npm run env:live && npm run test:live" and reports ok:false on its non-zero exit. This is expected and documented: the pipeline correctly aborts at convert-classic.mjs (178/724 real classic posts have un-prepassed shortcodes) because the shortcode pre-pass is P3-01, scheduled after this phase-2 task -- P2-06/P2-07/P2-08 all explicitly list "shortcode conversion quality (Phase 3)" as out of scope. The extraVerify wiring has no way to know a given phase-2 task's own env:live run is expected to stop partway through; it always treats exit!=0 as a failure. I ran the actual task-specified verification manually (both env:live modes, recorded step timings/tuning measurements in LIVE-TRIAGE.md, then npm run env:seed -- --reset && npm run test:e2e, which passed 491/491) and proceeded despite foundry_verify's ok:false, documenting why in the commit body.

P3-03's foundry_verify extraVerify again runs "LIVE_SKIP_ATTACHMENTS=1 npm run env:live && npm run test:live" and reports ok:false. This time the pipeline correctly gets all the way through convert-classic.mjs with only the 7 known/documented "owner cleanup" residual posts (unescaped HTML inside pre-existing native <code> tags in the classic content itself -- a source-data quality issue unrelated to shortcodes, out of scope per this task's own text) still failing textEqual, down from 178 before this task's fixes. The extraVerify harness has no way to represent "improved but not literally zero residual, and the residual is explicitly out of scope" as anything other than exit!=0 -> ok:false. Logging again since this is the third consecutive phase-3 task where the same structural mismatch between the harness's binary pass/fail and the flight's own documented, intentional residual-tracking model (LIVE-TRIAGE.md Findings) causes a false red.
